scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.e2e:server: cd server && mkdir -p .e2e && rm -f .e2e/e2e.db && SQLITE_DB_PATH=.e2e/e2e.db JWT_SECRET=e2e-secret NODE_ENV=test PORT=3001 node server.js
scripts.e2e:client: cd client && BROWSER=none npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.e2e:app: concurrently -n server,client "npm run e2e:server" "npm run e2e:client"
scripts.test:e2e: concurrently -k -s command-cypress -n server,client,cypress "npm run e2e:server" "npm run e2e:client" "node scripts/wait-for-app.js && cypress run"
